title: Miracle 19 and Rashad Khalifa Exposed
summary: The speaker recounts his past interactions with Rashad Khalifa regarding the 'Miracle 19' theory and the book 'Al-Quran: The Ultimate Miracle'. He explains how initial curiosity turned into concern as Khalifa's claims escalated, eventually declaring himself a messenger of God. The speaker discusses his attempts to debate Khalifa, challenges his claims, and ultimately cuts ties, refusing to support or validate his assertions.
